title: Codex shows 258K instead of 272K for magpie models because catalog omits effective_context_window_percent
head: ce9531f6181409142cf4dd0e4dfb2ac3a6d1f5c3
rootCause: Codex reads a catalog entry with no effective_context_window_percent as 95% of context_window; entriesAt in internal/codexcat wrote context_window and max_context_window but never the percent, on every generated entry (the model_catalog_json file, /v1/codex/models, Keep). Every catalog rendering goes through entriesAt, so the one place fixes all three.
unverifiedBoundaries: No real Codex on this box: the 95%/100% reading comes from the issue and Codex's own entry in the test fixture, not from running `codex debug models` against the new catalog.

Codex's own entries, which magpie only hands on, still keep Codex's own percent (95 in the fixture) even where magpie raises their window with the user's setting; the existing TestCodexNativeModelsTakeSetWindows pins that, and the issue asked not to change entries that mirror an upstream catalog.

effective_context_window_percent is now a key magpie owns (it comes from the model struct, like every other key it writes), so a value hand-edited into magpie-models.json for an entry magpie writes is replaced by 100 on the next sync.
The reporters' optional fallback (mirroring the window into config.toml's model_context_window) was not implemented.
